_comment: The site's navigation tree. Every branch/subcategory key is part of the public URL (/<branch>/<subcategory>/<slug>/), so renaming one moves every page under it and needs a redirect stub. Branches marked flat:true hold items directly, giving /<branch>/<slug>/. A branch with a link is a plain jump rather than an expandable node and holds no items. Order here is the order shown in the sidebar.

branches.label: Weapons
branches._signature_note: Which class the category is a signature weapon for. Set here rather than repeated in every item file; an item can still override it by declaring its own Signature Weapon row in availability.

branches._flat_note: Flat, not subcategorised: a vehicle class holds exactly one entry, which covers both its NATO and Pax Armata variants, so a subcategory layer would only repeat the page title. Sidebar order comes from each item's `order` and is the owner's: ground by weight, then rotary wing, fixed wing, naval. Not alphabetical, not grouped by domain.
branches.label: Vehicles
